about_the_game:
あれぐろもるとをきくゲーム Original Soundtrack

This is the official soundtrack for "Allegro Molto no Kiku Game", featuring eight original piano improvisation tracks composed and performed by Allegro Molto.

The album focuses on the experience of simply "listening" to the music, as if you are a viewer tuning into a live piano stream.
Gentle, mysterious, and occasionally unsettling — these pieces capture the mood of the game while standing alone as a musical experience.
